newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Heaven shares rise on sweet U.S. deal.
newsitem.headline: Heaven shares rise on sweet U.S. deal.

text.p: Shares in South African confectioner Sweets From Heaven Ltd rose on Thursday as the firm announced an expansion into the United States, dealers said.
Heaven said it had bought an effective 60 percent stake of U.S.-based Candy Headquarters Inc for an undisclosed sum.
"It looks like a good deal. The United States is a market with a lot of potential," one dealer said.
At 1255 GMT Heaven shares were up 32 cents to 274 cents.
The market had been expecting a deal from Heaven after the group in January said it had finally sealed a tie-up with leisure and retailing firm CNA Gallo Ltd and was looking for more ventures.
The firm had said then that it was already back at the negotiating table for other projects.
Heaven said the U.S. deal, which had South African Reserve Bank approval, could result in up to 125 outlets being opened in the U.S. market by the end of the decade.

Candy Headquarters, which operates through 28 franchised and two company-owned confectionery stores, is to be renamed Heaven USA and the entire management of Candy Headquarters would move to Heaven USA.
